text: Fixed. The issue was in `inifile/parser.py` line 40: `line.split("=")` split on every `=` (truncating values like `http://localhost:8000/?debug=1` at the second `=`), and `parts[1].split("#")[0]` truncated values at `#` (making `#ff8800` empty). I changed it to split only on the first `=` with `line.split("=", 1)` and keep the full value (just stripped of surrounding whitespace), matching the module's documented behavior. All tests pass and the issue's example now returns the exact values.
